youtube.title: Why Michelangelo publicly roasted Leonardo da Vinci 🐴 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Leonardo da Vinci asked Michelangelo one simple question in the middle of Florence... and got roasted over a horse he never finished. 🐴💀

The biggest beef of the Renaissance, as a group chat.

Leonardo or Michelangelo, who's the better artist? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on a real 1500s account: in Florence, Michelangelo mocked Leonardo for his giant bronze horse he "couldn't cast" and abandoned. Both later left their Palazzo Vecchio battle paintings unfinished.

#leonardodavinci #michelangelo #renaissance #arthistory #historymemes #history #shorts
